prompt_video:
Podcast-style video. Static camera, medium close-up framing locked to the start frame throughout; she keeps the exact face of the start frame. She speaks directly to someone off-camera, delivering multiple lines with natural pauses between them as if listening to responses.

No captions, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no words or letters appearing anywhere in the image at any moment; the only lettering in the whole clip is the pink neon sign already on the wall, unchanged. No background music. No camera movement or angle changes.

Realism: she looks and moves like a real woman filmed on a real podcast, never like AI: natural blinking, visible breathing, micro-expressions in her eyes, eyebrows and mouth, small head tilts and nods, hands and shoulders moving with what she feels, lips perfectly in sync with every word; real skin texture with pores, natural daylight from the side window on her face, loose hair strands that move slightly. Nothing stiff, nothing doll-like, nothing exaggerated.

She says each line exactly as written, only once, without repeating, adding or changing any word, and without "um", "uh" or "eh" that are not in the script. After her last line she says nothing else: she stays silent, listening, until the clip ends.

SCRIPT:

Línea 1: "Y una no repite tres veces algo que no le sirve."
Delivery: She only says her own lines, never the other person's questions or comments, and between lines stays silent, listening. Relaxed and sure of herself, with a small shrug.

Línea 2: "Ahora me pongo el jean, me miro de lado y digo: ah, ¿sí ves?"
Delivery: playful and proud, she turns her shoulders slightly as if checking herself in a mirror, raising one eyebrow on "¿sí ves?"; the words are only heard, never written on screen.

Audio: she speaks in a natural Colombian Spanish accent from Antioquia (paisa, like a woman from Medellín: melodic rising and falling intonation, clear crisp s, warm drawn vowels at the end of phrases; never costeño, never neutral, never Mexican) at a natural conversational speed, a touch more relaxed than her friend but never slow, with a warm, slightly lower, slightly husky voice of a Colombian woman in her early 30s, warm and confident, like someone who's been through it; she lowers her voice a little on the confidential parts, smiles while talking so the smile can be heard, and takes small audible breaths between phrases, like a real friend talking. The voice sounds like it's coming from a close podcast mic with little echo and reverberation. As her mouth moves away from the microphone, the audio changes in volume. Soft room tone of a small podcast studio, close-mic'd podcast sound.
motivo: revision de la app: Apareció escrito «¿sí ves?» en la pantalla, como un subtítulo.
